title: Smoky Mexican Pork Tacos
description: A flavorful twist on traditional pork tacos, with a smoky twist from chipotle peppers.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, cumin, garlic powder, and salt.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork chops.
Grill the pork chops for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F.
While the pork is cooking, warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
Once the pork is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of pork onto a shell, followed by a spoonful of chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
